model_output:
```sql
WITH nature_reserve AS (
  SELECT 
    park_name,
    geometry
  FROM 
    parks
  WHERE 
    leisure = 'nature_reserve' AND
    ST_Intersects(geometry::geometry, ST_GeomFromText('[2].geo_wkt_omitted')::geometry)
),
clipped_dem AS (
  SELECT 
    ST_Clip(
      r.rast,
      true,
      (SELECT geometry::geometry FROM nature_reserve LIMIT 1)
    ) AS clipped_rast
  FROM 
    public.dem_us r
  WHERE 
    ST_Intersects(r.rast, (SELECT geometry::geometry FROM nature_reserve LIMIT 1))
)
SELECT 
  (SELECT park_name FROM nature_reserve LIMIT 1) AS reserve_name,
  MAX((clipped_rast).val) AS max_elevation
FROM 
  clipped_dem;
```
